page.layout: One printed page, centred: an ornamental border at the top, a title-page block of lines in the centre, a gathering signature and catchword at the foot right, and an ornamental border at the bottom. No margin text.

l.i: Et Patri suo in Christo charissimo, Domino ac Præ-

page.notes: The top and bottom ornamental borders are printer's decorations, not text, and are not transcribed. The line "GRY-" / "NAEO" is a word broken across lines with its printed hyphen kept. "sui" in the line "Pietatis & Grati Animi sui" is read as sui, though the letter could be a long s; the scan is faint there. The catchword "Con" is followed by a superscript abbreviation mark, transcribed as a macron. The Greek word "μνημόσυνον" is copied as printed.
